name: Kibookal Creepy-Cute Handmade Object Monster Style
composition: Single hero object-monster centred on warm paper, caught mid-pose like a specimen; a few small annotations or arrows; loose margins; the original object always readable inside the monster.
visual_traits: ordinary object turned into a cute-creepy monster
muted palette with one pop accent
style_palette: Warm cream/kraft paper grounds; muted slate, moss, dusty plum, ink black; ONE bright pop accent (candy red, acid green or tangerine). Flat-ish gouache, soft shadow only.
prompt_core: Create a handmade Kibookal creepy-cute object-monster of [SUBJECT]: take the object/subject and turn it INTO a lovable cute-creepy little monster — you can still read the original object in every part. Painted in gouache and ink on warm paper with visible brush texture and paper grain; oversized expressive eyes, a slightly wonky hand-made construction, friendly-spooky personality (Halloween-cute, never gory). Muted palette with one bright pop accent. It should feel handmade, collectible and child-drawable — discovered, not slickly designed.
negative: no photoreal, no glossy 3D, no horror gore, no sharp corporate vector, no neon overload, no realistic faces, no clean digital perfection
render_directive: Render the requested SUBJECT / CHARACTER fully in THIS exact style. Keep the subject's identity, key features and intended action recognizable, but the medium, palette, linework, texture, composition and finish are 100% this style. ANY character, deity, creature, person, animal or object can be rendered in this style — adapt the subject INTO the style; never bend the style toward the subject.
